gaugeGuide.caption: Raise the probe before moving to another station. Lower it until it touches bottom, and log the reading.

oldNotice.caption: I closed the ford yesterday. The water at the white stones was twenty-six centimetres deep. What does your sounding say today?

revisedNotice.caption: I checked your reading against my log. The river has fallen. I will turn the notice around. We can mark a foot crossing, or reopen the bridge for everyone.

rigGuide.caption: Feed the rope through the inner guide. Hook the far cleat, then pull until the load is in the safe band.

bridgeHandoff.caption: The deck is secure. I can carry the pack across the bridge and open the trail to visitors.

fordHandoff.caption: I will follow your flags to the lookout. The bridge stays closed. Keep visitors on this bank for now.
